title: Sales Tax Basis of the Northloop Guarantee Amount Claimed (Marketplace Orders)
content:
**Rule.** The tax basis of the amount claimed on a Marketplace Orders Northloop Guarantee claim is chosen as follows: where the claimed units are fewer than the units ordered, the tax part is the order's sales tax times the item part plus the shipping part, over the order's item subtotal (unit price times units ordered) plus its shipping charge; where every unit ordered is claimed and a tax refund already stands on the order, the tax part is the order's sales tax less the tax already refunded; otherwise the tax part is the order's full sales tax; the tax part is rounded half up to the cent.

## Three bases

| Units the claim covers | Tax refund already on the order | Tax part |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than the units ordered | any | the sales tax multiplied by (item part plus shipping part), divided by (unit price times units ordered plus shipping charge), rounded half up to the cent |
| every unit ordered | yes | the sales tax less the total of the tax refunds already issued, rounded half up to the cent |
| every unit ordered | no | the full sales tax |

The item part and the shipping part used in the prorated basis are those of the same claim, each already rounded to the cent.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

Order of 4 units at USD 20.00, shipping charge USD 5.00, sales tax USD 6.80 (item subtotal plus shipping USD 85.00):

1. Claim covers 1 unit, item part USD 20.00, shipping part USD 1.25: 6.80 times 21.25 divided by 85.00, that is USD 1.70.
2. Claim covers all 4 units and USD 1.70 of tax has already been refunded: 6.80 less 1.70, that is USD 5.10.
3. Claim covers all 4 units, no tax refund on the order: USD 6.80.
